queue.question: Which current UE 5.8, SideFX Karma, and modern atmosphere-rendering ideas are transferable into KAOPU as vendor-independent atmosphere/lighting semantics and evaluator contracts without copying engine implementations or defaults?
queue.progress: R01 reviewed current UE 5.8 Sky Atmosphere/Volumetric Cloud, current SideFX Karma Sky Atmosphere, Hillaire 2020, Bruneton 2017, and Wilkie et al. 2021. Candidate decomposition now separates planet frame, emitter, atmospheric medium, surface coupling, radiative path query, cloud medium, evaluator policy, and camera/display policy. Multiple scattering is treated as a physical requirement whose numerical approximation remains evaluator policy. Dimensional checking and reference-query tests are candidate gates.
queue.nextGate: Define a tiny unit-typed atmosphere reference fixture and compare at least two evaluator families on identical AtmosphereState queries for transmittance and in-scattered radiance before candidate-complete promotion.

queue.question: Which modern procedural noise and field-composition methods are measurably better than current KAOPU typed-wave primitives for multiscale natural structure?
queue.progress: R01 primary-source review across Unreal Engine 5.8, current SideFX Houdini documentation, Blender 5.2 LTS, Pixar Wavelet Noise, and NVIDIA 2023 found no universal superior noise basis. Stronger transferable candidates are evaluation-footprint/filter policy, native differential outputs, explicit spectral/fractal composition law, explicit normalization, and evaluation-mode/bake provenance. A standard-library footprint probe was authored; no new runtime result is promoted yet.
queue.nextGate: Execute the footprint probe and run at least one Mother-domain cross-resolution fixture before candidate-complete promotion.
